g.text: KKT (private p=1/8) against all five comparators
Twelve trials per point; two graphs, one sampler. Ranges are descriptive.
Graph two reverses the full schedule; graph and order are confounded.
Lines connect measured sizes only. All 0 flagged calls retained.
Ratios: dashed 1.00 = parity; dotted 0.90 = strong-lead threshold.
